title: DESKTOP COMPUTERS DONATION
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons donated desktop computers to the Railway Police Station, Borivali, on 19th October 2026, as part of its community service initiative.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Horizons donated desktop computers to the Railway Police Station, Borivali, on 19th October 2026, as part of its community service initiative. The computers were generously contributed by Rtn. Sunil Bhandari to support the police force in their day-to-day administrative and operational work. This thoughtful contribution reflects Rotary's commitment to supporting public service institutions.
